content: Yauwe ina Kaba Kaiyaka siivatáoe tetelina
E Yauwe ilatuwokoigu idigo kana,
‘Tukówana vakuumgoina
ana maliyalina vakuumgoina goi guna Kaba Kaiyaka, o kada, “Guna Kaba Valoboda”, bei kovatāoe.
Kovatáoe ikavava, sinaena aba vatulúkwana dedeogaina Tukunu goi koyatogamogamōne namliyeta baige vabodaupa kaarekoina kovakosāine dedeogayana kotabōde.
Ikavava, teboro kokābi, kovaisīu, e yatana konanina kokatubayasīdi. Ikavava, rampa adi kaba yata kovaisīu be ina rampa koyatōidi.
Ikavava, insensi ana kaba kasala goura aba vatulúkwana matana goi go, vabodaupa kaarekoina toluyena goi koyatogamogamōne. Ikavava, Aba Kaiyakayana ana kaba siu ana taboda kaarekoina kovakosāine.
Ikavava, aba kasala vininabeso ana kaigabu manuna guna Kaba Kaiyakayana ana kaba siu toluyena goi kovatumasābe.
Ikavava, nokobaba kopwa guna Kaba Kaiyakayana be aba kasalayana go, nauyayanaidi goi koyāto namliyeta baige bwae kosiwōi.
Ikavava, guna Kaba Kaiyakayana kokāli go, aliyana ana kaba siu ana taboda kaarekoina kovakosāine.
Ikavava, pútuma aba kaipaku kokābi, guna Kaba Kaiyakayana be nakae kaga liliuna sinaena kosiwōi be kokimasabēdi umagu, e bei guna Kaba Kaiyakayana ma konanina kimaasabaidi umagu.
Ikavava, pútuma aba kaipaku kokābi, aba kasala vininabeso ana kaigabu manuna ma konanina koputumīdi be kokimasabēdi umagu, e bei aba kasalayana kimaasabaina toina.
Ikavava, pútuma aba kaipaku kokābi, nokobaba ma kaena koputūmi, e kokimasābe umagu.
E Eroni ma natunao komēdi guna Kaba Valoboda ana kaba siu goi kovaisivēdi.
Ikavava, kwama kimaasabaidi kokabīdi, Eroni kovalōsi. Niga pútuma aba kaipaku kokābi, tauyana koputūmi be kokimasābe umagu, e bei tauyana Tonúwala nakae ipaaisewa umagu.
Ikavava, Eroni natunao komēdi, kwama maanawedi goi kovalosīdi.

Ikavava, pútuma aba kaipaku kokābi, tauyadi koputumīdi tamadi nakae, e bei tauyadi Tonúwala nakae sipaaisewa manugu. Go moe nakae Eroni ma natunao be nakae tubunao liliudi kokimasabēdi umagu, e bei kidi nakae Tonúwala nakae sipaaisewa manugu ame tuta be nakae tuta simamaima yaidi.’
E kaga liliuna Yauwe ilovinaegu aguinuwedi, nakae aguinuwedi.
E tuwo tukówana vakuumgoina ana maliyalina vakuumgoina goi Yauwe ina Kaba Kaiyaka kavatáoe. Moe bogina tala tayamo ikavava ima sowóduwo Itipita mlina goi.

E Livai tubunao alatuwokoidi adigo kagu, ‘Aba Kaiyakayana kovatāoe.’ E ame nakae siguinuwe: Vabodakalova adi kaba táoya siyatoidi, e vabodakalovayadi simosidi. Niga logógana sivaisiudi rini goi be nakae kówala sivataoedi.
Sivataoedi ikavava, aba vatumna areko sikabi, Aba Kaiyakayana madabokina sivatum. Ikavava, aba vatumna aito sikabidi, aba vatumnayana areko sivapopo nakae boi Yauwe bogina ilovinaegu.
E aba vatulúkwana sikabidi, dedeoga sinaena sidodoidi. Niga aitakeo aiyuwo sikabidi, dedeogayana ana rini goura goi sivaisiudi. Ikavava, aba núwala sikabi, dedeogayana yatana goi sikailagasi.

Sikailagasi ikavava, sikaitakeve sinave Tukunu goi sivaisiu namliyeta baige vabodaupa kaarekoina sikabi, sivakosaine aba vatulúkwana dedeogaina sitabode nakae sopagu goi Yauwe bogina ilovina siguinuwe.
E teboro sikabi, sikaitakeve sinave Aba Valobodayana goi sivaisiu go, yawéyana dadavina vabodaupa kaarekoina toluyena goi siyato.
Ikavava, beredi sikabidi, teboroyana yatana goi sikailagasidi go, Yauwe matana goi sikatubayasidi nakae boi Yauwe bogina ilovinaegu.
E rampa adi kaba yata sikabi, Aba Valoboda goi sivaisiu go, youya dadavina vabodaupa kaarekoina toluyena goi siyato.
Ikavava, Yauwe matana goi rampayadi silotuvaninimidi sininínima nakae boi Yauwe bogina ilovinaegu.
E aba kasala goura sikabi, ina Kaba Valoboda goi sivaisiu go, vabodaupa kaarekoina toluyena goi siyatogamogamone.
E yatana goi insensi mainina dedevina siyato, e sigabu nakae boi Yauwe bogina ilovinaegu.
E ina Kaba Kaiyaka ana kaba siu ana taboda kaarekoina sikabi, sivakosaine.

Ikavava, aba kasala vininabeso ana kaigabu manuna sikabi aba siu toluyena goi sivatumasabe. Ikavava, yatana yoguyogu vininabeso manuna sikailagasi sigabusave, e kutukutu vininabeso manuna sikailagasidi, sigabudi nakae boi Yauwe bogina ilovinaegu.
E nokobaba kopwa sikabi, ina Kaba Valoboda be aba kasala kopwa go, nauyayanaidi goi siyato. Ikavava, bwae sitege nokobabayana goi sisiwoi moe adi kaba níkina.
E amoko goi Eroni ma natunao be yau nimama be aema bei kaanikidi.
Tutayana Yauwe ina Kaba Valoboda goi kasiu o kavalabelabena aba kasala goi, e mainao nimama be aema kanikidi. Ikavava baige kasiu nakae boi Yauwe bogina ilovinaegu.
E Yauwe ina Kaba Kaiyaka be aba kasala sikalidi. Ikavava, aliyana ana kaba siu ana taboda kaarekoina sivakosaine. E ameko goi paisewayana madabokina alukavave.
Yauwe ana káeyana tomoeeyalinaina Kaba Kaiyaka itaapasigi tetelina
E gaota isou Yauwe ina Kaba Valoboda iumai go, Yauweyana ana káeyana tomoeeyalina isiu ina Kaba Kaiyaka madabokina itapasigi.
E gaotayana Aba Valoboda iumai be nakae Yauwe ina kaeyanayana tomoeeyalina ivakayaodei, tauna geya itoboineguta bei Aba Valoboda goi asiu.

Go tutayana gaotayana Yauwe ilukake, e kai Isileli tubunao kakatubayasi bei katáoya kaketoiya go, gaotayana kasabookuliye. Nako goi isou, amoko goi kakaaiyaka. Moe nakae kaguuinuwe ima ketoiya ana madabokina goi.
Go gaotayana neta Yauwe geya ilukakeyeta, e kai Isileli tubunao geya kaketoiyeta, go sem kakaaiyaka ana kadókana ituko ina.

Moitamo. Yauwe ina gaota Aba Kaiyaka yatana goi ikaaiyaka maliyalina. Go sabamgo yeu sabeninimina gaotayana sinaena goi ikaaiyaka. Ame nakae kai Isileli tubunao madabokima ima ketoiya ana madabokina goi.

footnotes.text: Tukówana vakuumgoina: Ame nakona tukówana Mats ana kaba lukavava o Eipuru ana kaba vatowo.
